beforeRepairChecks.instruction: Turn off the water supply to the washer.

source.sourceExcerpt: 2. Turn off the water supply to the washer.

beforeRepairChecks.instruction: Remove the lower front access panel (see step 10 on page 4-11 for the procedure).

source.sourceExcerpt: 3. Remove the lower front access panel (see step 10 on page 4-11 for the procedure).

steps.instruction: Using a shallow pan to catch the water, unscrew the filter from the drain pump, and drain the water from the pump.

source.sourceExcerpt: 4. Using a shallow pan to catch the water, unscrew the filter from the drain pump, and drain the water from the pump.

steps.instruction: Loosen the clamp and remove the pump-to-tub hose from the drain pump.

source.sourceExcerpt: 5. Loosen the clamp and remove the pump-to-tub hose from the drain pump.

steps.instruction: Loosen the clamp and remove the pump-to-drain hose from the drain pump.
steps.expectedResult: REASSEMBLY NOTE: When you reconnect the hoses, align their tab(s) with the marks on the drain pump.

source.sourceExcerpt: 6. Loosen the clamp and remove the pump-to-drain hose from the drain pump. REASSEMBLY NOTE: When you reconnect the hoses, align their tab(s) with the marks on the drain pump.

steps.instruction: Using a flat-blade screwdriver, lift the rubber pad, and slide the pump to the left and unhook the bottom tab, then lift the pump out of the chassis floor slots.

source.sourceExcerpt: 7. Using a flat-blade screwdriver, lift the rubber pad, and slide the pump to the left and unhook the bottom tab, then lift the pump out of the chassis floor slots.

steps.instruction: Lift the wire cover on the drain pump, and disconnect the wire connector from the terminals.

source.sourceExcerpt: 8. Lift the wire cover on the drain pump, and disconnect the wire connector from the terminals.

steps.instruction: Remove the wires from the clip, and remove the drain pump from the washer.

source.sourceExcerpt: 9. Remove the wires from the clip, and remove the drain pump from the washer.

finalChecks.instruction: When reconnecting the pump-to-tub and pump-to-drain hoses, align hose tab(s) with the marks on the drain pump.

source.sourceExcerpt: REASSEMBLY NOTE: When you reconnect the hoses, align their tab(s) with the marks on the drain pump.

finalChecks.instruction: When reinstalling the drain pump, make sure that you completely reseat the rubber pad in its chassis floor slot.

source.sourceExcerpt: REASSEMBLY NOTE: When you reinstall the drain pump, make sure that you completely reseat the rubber pad in its chassis floor slot.
